Q20.The ratio of present ages of M and S is 5 : 7. M is 6 years younger than S. What will be the ratio of M's age to S's age after 9 years?
Step 1: Let their ages be 5x and 7x.
Present age of M = 5 x 3 = 15 years
Present age of S = 7 x 3 = 21 years
Age of M after 9 years = 15 + 9 = 24 years
Age of S after 9 years = 21 + 9 = 30 years
